verdict.rationale: Letta documents an `--ephemeral` headless mode that runs a task without persisting an agent, memory blocks, or MemFS. That is a first-party control over whether data is retained. Its default local and self-hosted modes keep all agent state on-device, giving users custody of their data. There is no documented way to delete agents, conversations, or memory, nor any retention-period or cloud-data deletion policy. missing for 10: documented deletion of agents/conversations/memory, configurable retention periods, cloud backup data deletion/purge controls, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Use --ephemeral to run a one-shot task without creating, resuming, or persisting an agent, memory blocks, or MemFS
all agent state, including messages, memory, and provider connections, stays on-device, and no Letta account is required.
This default local mode stores agent state on your machine and does not require a Letta login.
